conformance.reason: For the exact graph and bounded-local profile named by a conforming release bundle, every factory role, service, workflow and policy executes as a Wasm component. The reachable native kernel is limited to the eight declared generic substrate mechanisms and does not implement factory semantics. Admission requires a canonical Ed25519 certificate over the exact component/package closure and this inventory, verified against an independently persisted operator public key; native code treats semantic reports as opaque, digest-bound evidence. A release claim is valid only when this exact inventory, its signed package cohort, the optimized native artifact and the public-key-verifiable conformance reports are retained together by a content-addressed release manifest. The claim does not enable HTTP and does not assert the broader external North Star.
enforced_invariants: receipt executor identity remains the authoritative raw graph-node digest
derived executable identity and source provenance are persisted separately
static composition is one explicit graph-union principal
dynamic executions are independently grant-gated per run
local configuration cannot exceed manifest-bound ceilings or namespaces
every admission must carry a valid canonical certificate binding the exact release closure and this compiled native inventory
offline semantic validation report bytes are hashed but never interpreted by native code
first active-root bootstrap and selection require the immutable operator-pinned manifest digest; inactive candidate admission remains possible
root exports cannot run unless their manifest is the durable active manifest

operator_capacity.successor_rule: graph requirements must fit capacity; effective root fuel and memory are the graph/operator minimum

release_certification.private_key_location: external offline certifier only; never release or mechanism state

activation.mechanism: operator-pinned exact first-manifest trust plus independently pinned release-certifier public key, atomic exact verified-manifest selection, active BlobRef resolution and last-known-good restoration

clock.mechanism: wall clock plus explicitly requested durable wakes; past or equal deadlines are immediately due and only future delay is horizon-bounded

component-runner.mechanism: exact-digest Component Model instantiation with fuel, memory, output and wall-time bounds

http-transport.mechanism: validates generic envelope bounds and fails closed without networking

key-service.mechanism: non-exported Ed25519 key material plus OS secure entropy

keys: ring 0.17.14 Ed25519 and system secure random

operating_system_dependencies: configured-root filesystem persistence and fsync/rename semantics
Rust standard-library memory, synchronization and timer threads
standard input/output for the generic local launcher transport

verification_harness.durability_fault_controller: policy-neutral one-shot controller available only through the explicit conformance constructor; ordinary constructors and the production CLI install a disarmed controller and expose no input that can arm it
verification_harness.durability_fault_matrix: covers blob and component content writes, transaction and audit commits, component dispatch/completion/receipt replay, activation commit/rollback/boot recovery with paired opaque graph/state pointers, and stale two-handle writer fencing

limitations: The accepted executable cache is bound through canonical manifest metadata and a derivation descriptor; independent recomposition is release evidence rather than native policy.
Semantic role coverage and complete-graph execution are release evidence produced outside the native kernel; the kernel neither interprets nor substitutes for those proofs.
The signed local profile deliberately disables HTTP. Enabling remote transport creates a different profile, package identity and conformance duty.
Static composition uses one explicit graph-union principal. Finer per-consumer isolation applies only to dynamic executions in this version.

The component-owned capability services are bounded deterministic reference services; this release does not claim feature parity with unrestricted compilers, workspaces, providers or deployment systems.
The v1 certifier public key is immutable after mechanism initialization; explicit operator key rotation and revocation governance remain outside package authority.
The retained optimized native artifact is exact to its attested host target and toolchain. Another operating system, architecture or toolchain requires a new native attestation and release bundle.
